Research profile icons from Academicons 1.9.5 by James Walsh and contributors.

Source: https://github.com/jpswalsh/academicons/tree/67339d46e44693f438529e0eb6eebbe3d8c9579d/svg
Files: google-scholar.svg, semantic-scholar.svg, scopus.svg, arxiv.svg,
       ideas-repec.svg (the IDEAS/RePEc logo), researchgate.svg.

License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, as declared by each upstream SVG's
Creative Commons/RDF metadata. The full license is in LICENSE.txt.
Upstream license notice:
https://github.com/jpswalsh/academicons/blob/67339d46e44693f438529e0eb6eebbe3d8c9579d/README.md#license

Local changes: removed editor metadata, unused stroke declarations and element
IDs; added a shared class, decorative accessibility attributes and currentColor.
Path geometry, group transforms and view boxes are unchanged. The renderer
inlines these local SVGs; no icon service or CDN is contacted at runtime.

The brand names and logos identify their respective services and remain the
property of their respective owners.
